author: Marcus Johnson
comment: Jennifer knew every detail of the building and answered questions I hadn't thought to ask. The whole process took three weeks end to end.

author: Sarah Jenkins
comment: Great experience overall. The listing photos undersold the garden — it's much bigger in person.

author: Raj Patel
comment: Responsive, straightforward, no pressure. Exactly what I wanted from an agent.

author: Emily Carter
comment: The property was as described, but scheduling the second viewing took longer than I'd have liked.

author: Victor Moreau
comment: David handled a tricky chain without any drama. Would recommend to anyone buying in Malibu.

author: Leila Hassan
comment: Good value and a quick turnaround. The paperwork could be simpler but that's not on the agency.

author: Yuki Sato
comment: Two viewings were rescheduled at short notice. The property itself was fine.

author: Miguel Santos
comment: Laura went well beyond what I expected, including chasing the surveyor twice.

author: Clara Hoffmann
comment: Professional throughout. The virtual tour saved me two trips across town.
